Zoe: FYI during a quick onboarding demo I hit two weird things in the Node sampleapp: logs briefly drop the req-id and we show raw auth headers in a debug trace when OTel is enabled.

Zoe: Quick repro I used (local Docker):
1) docker build -t sampleapp . && docker run -e REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO -e OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp -p 8080:8080 sampleapp
2) curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xyz' http://localhost:8080/api/generate -i
3) hit several times, sometimes retries happen from the client and the logs flip to DEBUG for a burst

Zoe: Example log chunk (sanitized):
```
INFO  [req=7g4] incoming /api/generate
DEBUG [req=] http.request headers: { authorization: 'Bearer sk-test-xyz' }
INFO  [req=] served 200
```

Rahul: That pattern screams "instrumentation initialized after our logger". Some OTEL bootstrappers call logging.basicConfig or set child logger levels which can override previously chosen levels. If our logger snapshot config at init it won't see changes.

Mei: Also possible our request-id middleware is attached to express layer and OTel wraps express internals, re-emitting events without the original req object so the logger middleware loses the attached id on retries.

Zoe: I tried reversing imports so telemetry registers before logger init and repro rate dropped to ~5%. Not acceptable as a required user step.

Rahul: Agreed. Proposed SDK changes: 1) make logger evaluate level lazily on first log or expose logger.reconfigure() that telemetry can call post-instrumentation, 2) attach reqid to the raw http.IncomingMessage prototype instead of req.locals so wrappers can't drop it, 3) improve redactor to coerce Buffer/Uint8Array and deep-merge nested header shapes.

Mei: For redaction: match keys like /authorization|api[_-]?key|token/i and mask to "<redacted:...last6>" so we retain tail digits for debug triage. Also handle nested lists/maps and Buffer types.

Zoe: I've opened a tiny repro branch and added a `stress-repro.sh` script to hit the race. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp-telemetry/branch/bootstrapping-noise

telemetry-bot: Created ticket DX-7499: "otel bootstrapping can override logger level and cause req-id loss; redactor misses instrumented header shapes". Linked repro branch.

Rahul: I'll prototype lazy-eval + logger.reconfigure() this sprint. If we add reconfigure hooks we should document the hook API and call it from telemetry.register() automatically. That gives backward compat and removes order dependency.

Mei: I'll work on the redactor patch and add unit tests for Buffer and nested header cases. I'll also add an express integration test that simulates OTel wrapping to validate reqid survives.

Zoe: Immediate onboarding mitigation: add a CLI startup check that warns if OTEL_* env vars are present and REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL is not explicitly set to the desired value, plus a README blurb: "If you see noisy debug logs during onboarding set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL or call telemetry.register() before logger.init()."

Rahul: One more edge: serverless cold starts - instrumentations may init in different orders depending on handler wiring. We'll include a lambda snippet showing safe init order and an example calling `logger.reconfigure()` at handler bootstrap.

Mei: I'll also add a small migration note for existing customers explaining the new reconfigure hook and its semantics.

telemetry-bot: DX-7499 updated: assignees Rahul, Mei; priority P2; status triage.
